title: Announce broadcaster mailbox overflow and recover through the lagged stream contract
outcome: Broadcaster mailbox eviction is counted and announced without blocking the commit lock, and the existing lagged stream recovery restores missed state.
acceptance: 1. A deterministic production-broadcaster test forces repeated mailbox overflow and verifies a retained loss announcement, the exact eviction count and revision range, and recovery through the actual HTTP lagged-marker and snapshot path.

2. Overflow never blocks a producer holding StateInner; the loss announcement survives further eviction and precedes retained work, while the P0 stream sequence and client recovery contracts remain intact.
3. The server contract documentation describes bounded overflow and recovery, and the full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed stacked input.

blockers.detail: Wait for Coder's P0 stream-contract commit and completion/landing of ordering parent before stacked implementation. The attempted explicit after-parent dependency was refused as work_dependency_cycle; preserve the optional hierarchy and this coordination blocker instead.
